notes:
What's new in 0.26.0

• Up and Down between rows on Home and Discover keep your place: from the 5th title, you land on the 5th title of the next row.
• Discover has a new Explore row:
  – Rabbit Hole, now a web: jump between films, directors, actors, composers, genres, franchises and themes.
  – Deep Cuts: case files of things almost nobody has seen. A new dig every visit.
  – Franchise Journeys: Marvel, Star Wars, Alien, Predator, DC, Middle-earth, Dragon Ball and more, in recommended, story or release order, with what's coming next.
  – Double Feature: two films that belong together, with a name and the reason why.
  – Moodboard: choose a feeling (Rainy Sunday, Late-Night Paranoia, Existential Sci-Fi…), not a genre.
  – Watch Challenges: curated lists that tick themselves off as you watch (Trakt included).
  – Time Machine: pick any year from 1950 for its biggest films, TV, anime, faces, music and hidden gems.
  – Blind Date: a film picked for you with only clues. Commit, then it's revealed.
• Movies, Series and Anime: Pick for Me is now Help Me Choose, with Pick for Me and the new This or That game, which learns what you're drawn to.
